summary: Silo Pharma filed an 8-K disclosing an asset purchase agreement with Parkview Consulting LLC, acquiring software, technology, domain names, and related IP. Consideration was 165,000 shares of common stock, subject to a 12-month lock-up with customary exceptions. The seller's sole member, Corwin Yu, is the lead strategic advisor on the company's Cryptocurrency Advisory Board, indicating a related-party aspect. The shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) as an unregistered sale. The filing notes no dollar value or premium. Watch for post-closing integration and potential conflicts of interest given the seller's advisory role.
